answer: A bond of 47% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in jetty, and echo reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 25 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vertex account. Each duplicate costs another 191 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
